text:
emily: I opened PR to merge small 429/timeouts/context-limit notes into a single canonical error-ref page: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4501

raj: Nice. Can we add a tiny 'first steps' checklist at the top (detect 429 vs timeout, attempt graceful fallback, capture trace) — 3 bullets max.

anna: I'll add short SDK snippets (Node + Python) showing graceful fallback + the recommended header X-RI-Retry-Mode=graceful. Keep them one-call examples.

raj: Also include a one-line migration note for teams using the old client-side retry wrapper: disable wrapper or set header X-RI-Retry-Mode=disabled to avoid double retries.

anna: Draft Node snippet:
```js
const r = await client.generate({ prompt });
if (r.status === 429) await client.generate({ prompt, model: 'gpt-lite', headers: { 'X-RI-Retry-Mode': 'graceful' } });
```

anna: Draft Python snippet:
```py
r = client.generate(prompt)
if r.status_code == 429:
    client.generate(prompt, model='gpt-lite', headers={'X-RI-Retry-Mode':'graceful'})
```

emily: Add a tiny troubleshooting bullet for streaming partials + 429: abort, mark partial incomplete, resume only if backend supports `X-RI-Resume-Offset`.

doc-bot: lint: docs/error-ref.md has 2 broken links; CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/4890/logs

emily: I'll run the link-sweep after Anna's commits. Target merge Tue EOD. Thanks :thumbsup:
